summary: A slow, heavy hexacopter that flies over a target and drops bombs on it. It is strong against infantry, light vehicles and buildings, but it is a low flyer and any weapon that reaches low aircraft can shoot it down.

sections.title: Bombing run
sections.how: Select the Baba Yaga and left-click an enemy. To bomb a spot, hold Ctrl and left-click the ground, or press Force fire and tap the ground.
sections.body: The Baba Yaga flies to the target and hangs over it while it drops its bombs, so it bombs what it is flying over rather than a distant point. Each bomb blasts a small area, which makes a cluster of infantry or light vehicles a good target. It is slow and has to come close, so send it against a target that is not protected by anti-air.

sections.title: Clip and reload
sections.how: Press Reload to send it to the nearest drone workshop now, or let the clip run out and it goes by itself.
sections.body: The Baba Yaga carries four bombs and spends one per drop. Once the clip is empty it returns to a drone workshop, waits there while the bombs are reloaded and its damage is repaired, then it is ready again. With no workshop left it cannot rearm; once it is empty it stays in the air and slowly loses health. Pressing Stop sends it home even with bombs left. Reload shows only while bombs are missing; afterwards the Baba Yaga waits idle at the workshop. With no workshop left, Reload plays an error sound and nothing happens.

sections.title: No radio link
sections.how: Fly it through a Russian jammer's circle.
sections.body: The Baba Yaga has no radio or satellite link, so a Pole-21's jammer does not stop it, blind it or make it fall. It keeps flying and bombing inside the circle. Only weapons that can hit low flyers can bring it down.

sections.title: Low and fragile
sections.how: Keep it away from riflemen, autocannons and anti-air; route it around apartment blocks, churches and office towers.
sections.body: It flies low, inside the reach of every weapon that can fire at low flyers: rifle fire, autocannons and dedicated anti-air. Tanks, artillery and anti-tank teams cannot hit it. Its light frame cannot take much fire, and flying over a building taller than its rotor height makes it crash.

weak: Tall buildings on its flight path
tips: Aim at a cluster: the blast catches the units next to the target.
A tank is a poor target for its bombs; leave armour to anti-tank weapons and the Ratel S.
It is slow and cannot dodge, so clear the anti-air before sending it in.
A Pole-21 cannot stop it; hunt the jammer with guns or tanks instead.
Let the clip run out and it flies home by itself to reload and repair.
Fly around apartment blocks, churches and office towers: it is too low to cross them.
